standard_prerequisites.name: The correspondence between schemes over the base and over the localizations
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The equivalence of categories described in the equation labelled equivalence
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers morphisms and blowing up data between the base and the localizations at the points.

standard_prerequisites.name: Isomorphism of the fibres of corresponding schemes
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that the fibres of corresponding schemes at the corresponding points are isomorphic
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the fibre over one of the points with the fibre over the corresponding point, which is what allows matching closed points under the correspondence.

core_obligations: From the base to the localizations (proof lines 1512-1527): given a sequence of blowups of the base over the points, the first blowing up is in one of those points, say the first; applying the correspondence produces a blowing up over the first localization and leaves the others unchanged; at each further step either one blows up one of the remaining points of the base, which is clear, or one blows up a closed point of the fibre over the first point, in which case the isomorphism of fibres produces a corresponding closed point over the localization; iterating constructs the required factorizations for all the localizations.

From the localizations to the base (proof lines 1527-1533): conversely, given sequences of blowups over each of the localizations, the same procedure run in reverse constructs a sequence of blowups of the base in closed points lying over the given points.
proof_roadmap: Follow the first blowing up of the base through the correspondence.
Match further closed points of the fibre using the isomorphism of fibres.
Iterate, and run the construction in reverse for the converse direction.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a sequence of blowups of the base in closed points lying over a finite set of points exists if and only if for each point there is a sequence of blowups of the localization at that point in closed points lying over it, under the correspondence of the equivalence (statement lines 1494-1510). Both directions are proved (proof lines 1512-1533) by tracking the points blown up through the equivalence and matching points of the fibres using the isomorphism of the fibres. H3: a two directional construction written out in full.
